verdict.rationale: Capacities documents its own sync. It is offline-first, and changes "get synchronized as soon as you're back online" across a desktop app and a mobile companion app. Nothing in the evidence says this sync is end-to-end encrypted or that the vendor cannot read your notes, and that is a central part of the story. missing for 10: any documentation of end-to-end or zero-knowledge encryption, details of multi-device sync scope and reliability, independent or hands-on corroboration of sync.
